subject: Request: Incident evidence snapshot + SIG/CAIQ items
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Possible exposure — request for IR evidence + SOC 2/SIG follow-up

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads up from our side: we detected a transient spike in 3rd-party API error rates on 2028-03-10 that we traced to calls routed through our Redwood integration. No customer data appears to be exfiltrated, but our security and compliance teams have asked for a compact package so we can close our internal review.

Specifically we need: 
- A short incident timeline (what happened, start/end, mitigation actions).
- A sample of request/response logs (redacted) or guidance on how to pull S3/Cloud logs for our tenant.
- Answers to a small SIG/CAIQ subset focused on data retention, logging, and incident notification timelines (we'll attach the subset after this).
- Any SOC 2-relevant artifacts or references you can share (attestation date, contact).

We'd like to get a compact bundle by EOD Pacific on Thu 2028-03-15 if possible to meet our audit window. Can you confirm?

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Daniel Park
Senior Security Manager
FinAnalytics
security@finanalytics.com

What I'll do now: 
- Attach a 2-page incident snapshot (preliminary) summarizing timeline and mitigations.
- Kick off a telemetry export (sample logs) and share a secure link when ready.
- Provide our SOC 2 point-of-contact and the latest attestation date, plus a compact SIG/CAIQ mapping for the items you called out.

CC'ing Marissa (security ops) and Sean (IR lead) to coordinate extracts and the evidence bundle. Talk soon,

Subject: Re: Possible exposure — request for IR evidence + SOC 2/SIG follow-up

Naomi / team — quick internal note and ETA on artifacts.

Per Naomi's snapshot: the event on 2028-03-10 was a routing misconfiguration combined with a transient upstream error that caused elevated 5xx rates for a small subset of tenants between 01:12 and 01:46 UTC. No auth tokens were observed leaving our environment; KV cache was disabled for the affected routing tier which caused higher request retries.

What I'm doing now (ETA in parentheses):
- Preparing logs: pulling a 72-hour export around 2028-03-10 from our request-telemetry bucket (s3-logs-sample-20280310.tar.gz). Will scrub PII and redact user identifiers (ETA: 6 hrs).
- Generating a short forensic timeline (timeline.csv) and a checksum manifest for the bundle (ETA: 3 hrs).
- Filling the SIG/CAIQ compact mapping (sig-caiq-mapping-compact.xlsx) with explicit answers for the items Daniel requested (ETA: 4 hrs).

Soojin — can you confirm whether the retention clause we reference in item 3 of the SIG mapping should include Guided Retention (30 days) or Customer-controlled exports? FinAnalytics asked specifically about how long request logs are retained in raw form vs aggregated metrics.

I'll upload the bundle to our secure share and post the link into this thread. If FinAnalytics wants a brief call to walk the artifacts, Naomi / Daniel, we can do a 20-minute sync this afternoon.

-Marissa
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@finanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Possible exposure — request for IR evidence + SOC 2/SIG follow-up

Hi Daniel — thanks for your patience. Per the requests below we've prepared a compact evidence bundle and small compliance packet. Summary below and links/attachments at the end.

Executive summary (customer-facing):
- Event: elevated API 5xx rate due to a routing misconfiguration impacting a small subset of tenants.
- Window: 2028-03-10T01:12:00Z — 2028-03-10T01:46:00Z (root cause identified and routing rule reverted at 01:46 UTC).
- Impact: transient increased error rates, increased retries; no confirmed data exfiltration and no authentication compromise.
- Mitigation: routing rule reverted, autoscaling backstop temporarily increased, and additional health-check gating added to the routing layer.

Package contents (attached / secure link):
- redwood_incident_snapshot_20280314.pdf (2pp summary, customer-friendly language)
- s3-logs-sample-20280310.tar.gz (anonymized sample logs; hashed manifest included)
- sig-caiq-mapping-compact.xlsx (answers to the SIG/CAIQ subset you requested)
- timeline.csv (forensic timeline entries)

SOC 2 note: our most recent SOC 2 type II report was issued 2027-11-01. For attestation requests we can share a letter and contact to the compliance team under an NDA.

Secure download: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/finanalytics/20280314-evidence (link expires in 7 days)
HubSpot note: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DA-82731 (internal record)

If you'd like a quick walkthrough of the artifacts, I'm available Fri 2028-03-16 09:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–15:00 PT for a 20-minute call. Otherwise we'll assume delivery by link is sufficient and will close the request after you confirm receipt.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
